issue.title: Release pinning: run each agent process on an immutable per-process sase release

task_type_fields.proposal: An epic that gives every runner process an immutable per-process sase release (code snapshot) so a live sase update can never tear a running agent's imports; this makes Tier 1-2 update-skew failures impossible (proposed by sase-1j6.9, epic sase-1j6).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1j6's plan settled that release pinning is a separate epic; sase-1j6 only recovers skew deaths once and prevents the refresh-path bug.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1j6.9 (land phase of epic sase-1j6, follow-up P2): pinning makes Tier 1-2 update skew impossible, which is the reopen condition for the auto-restart design.

payload.description: Both reshape update-skew recovery; pinning removes Tier 1-2 skew
